queries.window: posted_on BETWEEN '2026-10-01' AND '2026-10-31' (also passed as from/to)
queries.Q_SPEND: SELECT SUM(expense_minor) FROM txn WHERE <window> [AND account='<mask>']
queries.Q_NET_SPEND: SELECT SUM(expense_minor) - SUM(CASE WHEN money_kind='refund' AND direction='inflow' THEN amount_minor ELSE 0 END) FROM txn WHERE <window> AND account='<mask>'
queries.Q_FEES: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN lower(description) LIKE '%fee%' THEN expense_minor ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN money_kind='refund' AND direction='inflow' AND lower(description) LIKE '%fee%' THEN amount_minor ELSE 0 END) FROM txn WHERE <window> [AND account='<mask>']
queries.Q_INTEREST: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN lower(description||' '||COALESCE(category,'')) LIKE '%interest%' THEN expense_minor ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN money_kind='refund' AND direction='inflow' AND lower(description) LIKE '%interest%' THEN amount_minor ELSE 0 END) FROM txn WHERE <window>
queries.Q_PAID_TO_code: SELECT SUM(amount_minor) FROM txn WHERE <window> AND account='<mask>' AND direction='inflow' AND money_kind IN ('card_payment','loan_payment')
queries.Q_PAID_TO_design: SELECT SUM(payment_minor) FROM txn WHERE <window> AND account='<mask>'
queries.Q_PRINCIPAL_design: SELECT SUM(payment_minor) FROM txn WHERE <window> AND account='3333'
queries.Q_GUIDE_PAYMENTS: SELECT SUM(amount_minor) FROM txn WHERE <window> AND money_kind='card_payment'

confidence_rule: moneyQueryQuality with selection {from:'2026-10-01',to:'2026-10-31'}; complete confirmed coverage, so only estimated_membership applies: penalty=min(35,max(11,ceil(35*estimated_minor/total_minor))), total=all window rows both directions (money-query-quality.js:41-42); >=90 High, >=70 Medium, else Low (line 75).
